objectName: CineGlide Pro 3-Axis Motorized Camera Slider & Pan/Tilt Head
tagline: Motorized 2020 V-Slot linear camera dolly with 3× NEMA17 steppers, silent TMC2209 256-microstep drivers, 3:1 herringbone pan/tilt head & ESP32 keyframe controller
description: Commercial 3-axis motorized camera sliders like the Edelkrone SliderONE + HeadPLUS ($899–$1,299) or Syrp Genie II 3-Axis kit ($899+) charge nearly $1,000 for CNC brackets around standard V-slot rails and stepper motors. Our DIY build combines 9 rigid PETG/PLA+ printed motion blocks and a 3:1 geared pan/tilt gimbal with $75.40 of off-the-shelf 2020 aluminum extrusion, 3× NEMA17 steppers, silent TMC2209 drivers, Delrin V-wheels, and an ESP32 OLED keyframe controller.
functionSummary: Synchronizes linear carriage travel (Axis 1) along dual 2020 V-slot rails via a tensioned GT2-6mm timing belt with continuous 360° pan (Axis 2) and ±90° tilt (Axis 3) driven by three NEMA17 stepper motors under 256-microstep StealthChop TMC2209 control for ultra-smooth video parallax and long-exposure astro time-lapses.

originalProduct.name: Edelkrone / Syrp 3-Axis Motorized Camera Slider & Pan-Tilt Motion Head
originalProduct.whyExpensive: Low-volume cinema gear markup, proprietary app ecosystems, and $250 add-on battery brackets for standard NEMA17 + TMC2209 motion hardware.

keyMechanisms: 4-wheel Delrin V-Slot gantry carriage with eccentric spacer preload riding on dual 2020 anodized aluminum extrusions
Closed-loop GT2-6mm fiberglass timing belt drive with M5 sliding idler tensioner block on the right rail end
Axis-2 360° pan turntable riding on a 6808-2RS thin-section bearing with a 3:1 printed herringbone ring gear reduction
Axis-3 cantilever tilt U-yoke with Arca-Swiss quick-release clamp driven by a pancake NEMA17 stepper and silent TMC2209 UART drivers
engineeringNotes: Print PRT-01 (Motor End Block), PRT-02 (Idler End Block), and PRT-04 (Gantry Carriage Plate) in PETG with 4 perimeters and 40% cubic infill for maximum rail rigidity.
Print PRT-06 (60T Pan Ring Gear) at 0.16mm layer height with Arachne perimeter generator enabled for smooth tooth engagement.
All 9 printed part types (12 items including 4 fold-out outrigger legs) pack onto 2 Bambu Lab A1 plates.
materialsNeeded: PETG Filament (~340g) for rail end blocks, outrigger legs, gantry carriage deck & tilt yoke
PLA+ Filament (~155g) for pan turntable housing, 60T ring gear, Arca-Swiss cradle & controller case
2020 V-Slot Extrusions + 3× NEMA17 Steppers + 3× TMC2209 Drivers + GT2 Belt/Pulleys + 4× V-Wheels + 6808 Bearing + ESP32 OLED
whatGetsPrinted: PRT-01: Left 2020 Rail Drive Block & NEMA17 Stepper Mount (96×78×58mm)
PRT-02: Right 2020 Rail Idler Block with M5 Belt Tensioner (88×78×54mm)
PRT-03: Fold-Out Articulated All-Terrain Outrigger Legs ×4 (115×36×24mm)
PRT-04: 4-Wheel V-Slot Gantry Carriage Deck with Eccentric Bores (124×108×14mm)
PRT-05: Axis-2 Rotary Pan Turntable Housing & 6808 Bearing Seat (102×102×46mm)
PRT-06: 60-Tooth GT2 Pan Reduction Ring Gear 3:1 (92×92×16mm)
PRT-07: Axis-3 Cantilever Tilt Gimbal U-Yoke Arm (108×74×88mm)
PRT-08: Arca-Swiss Quick-Release Camera Tilt Cradle (78×64×24mm)
PRT-09: Snap-Fit TMC2209 + ESP32 Motion Controller Side Case (92×62×34mm)
whatGetsBought: OTS-01: Dual 2020 V-Slot Black Anodized Aluminum Extrusion Rails (1000mm)
OTS-02: NEMA17 Bipolar Stepper Motors ×3 (Slide, Pan, Tilt)
OTS-03: BIGTREETECH TMC2209 SilentStepStick UART Drivers ×3 (256-Microstep)
OTS-04: 3m GT2-6mm Fiberglass Belt + 3× 20T Aluminum Pulleys + 2× Idlers
OTS-05: 4× Delrin POM V-Slot Wheels + Eccentric Nuts + 6808-2RS Bearing
OTS-06: ESP32 + 0.96" OLED Keyframe Controller & 2.5mm Shutter Trigger Cable
OTS-07: USB-C PD 12V/20V Trigger Board + M5 T-Nuts & 1/4"-20 Camera Screw Kit
OTS-08: Aluminum Arca-Swiss Quick-Release Clamp & Bubble Level
